<b>Weavelight</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases the speed and quantity of passive [[Silk]] regeneration from [[Silk Heart]]s.

== Usefulness ==
* Speed up Silk regeneration by 35%. This reduces the time from 1.45 seconds to 0.9 seconds for the first strand, and from 3.9 seconds to slightly more than 2.5 seconds for all other strands.
** This effect is still delayed by any change in the amount of Silk.
* Increases the maximum Silk that can be regenerated by 1 strand. This effectively acts as an extra Silk Heart.
** With all 3 Silk Hearts, Hornet can regenerate 4 strands of Silk over roughly 9 seconds total. This means Hornet can use {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} without any other source of Silk.
* [[Clawline]] can be used more often, which speeds up platforming. This is especially useful on [[Mount Fay]] where waiting for Silk regeneration risks taking damage from the cold. 
** Also allows for [[Silkspeed Anklets]] and [[Needolin]] to be used for longer without other sources of Silk.

== How to Acquire ==
Found after defeating the [[Moss Mother]]s in [[Weavenest Atla]].
